rule: Use the ordinary full post-settle authority plan's zero-base initial gait clocks for resumed walking only. Preserve the development seed and seed-modulo phase of the fresh prefix, the existing flexed standing controller, walking policy, amplitude ramp, contact rules, memory continuity after startup, horizons, and all evaluators.
basis: The retained V23 resume starts every limb at gait step 240 from seed 40200 modulo 360, whereas the normal full-authority zero-base startup plan starts at zero. This tests that explicit startup difference, not an inferred cause of later contact losses or a phase sweep.
